description: In the specified finite chain, a walk of length \(n\) from \(a\) to \(b\) satisfies \(b\le a+n\).
signature:
Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.ExpressiveLimits.finite_chain_walk_bound {N n : ℕ} {a b : Fin (N + 2)}
  (h :
    Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.ExpressiveLimits.Walk Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.ExpressiveLimits.chainEdge n a b) :
  ↑b ≤ ↑a + n
